title: 最后一趟
logline: 退休长途货车司机完成最后一次跑车，将三十年公路人生托付给徒弟，诠释赶路人与公路的羁绊。

shots.narrationZh: 三十年的货，今天最后一趟。
shots.narrationEn: This is the last run after thirty years on the road.
shots.visual: Dawn cargo yard, a retired long-haul truck driver checks the cargo manifest while his apprentice stands beside a parked heavy-duty truck.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪平静释然，语速稍缓，“三十年”稍作停顿，“最后一趟”轻收，气息沉缓

shots.narrationEn: I've taken this route out of the city thousands of times.
shots.visual: Heavy truck drives along the suburban expressway leaving the city, the driver glances at the shrinking urban skyline in the rearview mirror.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪松弛平和，语速平稳，“几千遍”重读带淡淡感慨，气息平稳悠长

shots.narrationZh: 服务区的泡面，还是老味道。
shots.narrationEn: The instant noodles at the rest stop still taste the same as always.
shots.visual: Noon highway rest stop, the old driver sits alone on the concrete steps eating instant noodles, his apprentice fills the truck's water tank nearby.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温怀念旧，语速稍慢，“老味道”重读带暖意，气息轻缓

shots.narrationZh: 暴雨夜的路，看不清尽头。
shots.narrationEn: The road disappears into the rain on this stormy night.
shots.visual: Stormy night, the truck's headlights cut through the pouring rain, the driver grips the steering wheel tightly as the wipers swing rapidly.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪沉静坚毅，语速稍缓，“看不清尽头”重读，气息沉稳带雨夜沉郁感

shots.narrationEn: It's time for someone else to take the wheel for a while.
shots.visual: Pre-dawn rest stop, the apprentice gets into the driver's seat, the old man leans against the door handing him a lit cigarette.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪释然欣慰，语速平稳，“该换人”稍作停顿，“开一段了”轻收，气息松弛舒展

shots.narrationEn: The wildflowers by the mountain road have bloomed thirty times over the years.
shots.visual: Early morning winding mountain road, the heavy truck drives along the cliff edge, the driver looks out at blooming wildflowers on the roadside.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪豁达舒展，语速稍快，“三十回”重读带笑意，气息轻快明亮

shots.narrationEn: The cargo arrived safe, and so did I, all these years.
shots.visual: Sunrise at the destination cargo yard, the old driver and apprentice count the delivered goods together, smiling.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪踏实自豪，语速平稳，“货到了”“没跑丢”稍重读，气息沉稳有力

shots.narrationEn: Here's the key, the road goes on for you.
shots.visual: Parking lot after unloading, the retired driver hands the truck key to his apprentice, who receives it with both hands.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪郑重温和，语速稍缓，“钥匙给你”稍作停顿，“路接着走”重读，气息平稳带期许

shots.narrationZh: 路会记得每一个跑完它的人。
shots.narrationEn: The road remembers everyone who has driven its full length.
shots.visual: The apprentice drives the truck away, the old man stands by the roadside waving as the vehicle disappears into the distance.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪释然悠远，语速放缓，“路会记得”稍作停顿，“跑完它的人”重读，气息悠长舒展

shots.narrationEn: Quality trucks accompany you through every mile of the road.
shots.visual: Close-up of the heavy truck brand logo on the front grille, with the product tagline displayed below.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温暖收束，语速放缓，“好车”“每段路”重读，气息轻缓柔和
